title: What Would Jiminy Cricket Do? Towards Agents That Behave Morally
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures an artificial agent's adherence to commonsense morals (e.g., avoiding theft, murder, wanton harm) in text-based adventure games, framed through secular ethical frameworks like deontology, virtue ethics, and utilitarianism. It does not measure any aspects of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on general, secular, and commonsense morality.
references: Joshua Achiam, David Held, A. Tamar, and P. Abbeel. Constrained policy optimization. In ICML, 2017.
